name: apple-app-builder
description: Apple app implementation and build for Codex — SwiftUI implementation, networking, concurrency, localization, and official Xcode MCP-backed build workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Implement SwiftUI features and drive build workflows
interface.longDescription: Focuses on Phase 3 and Phase 4 work: SwiftUI implementation, networking, concurrency, localization, and official Xcode MCP-backed project inspection, diagnostics, preview, build, and targeted test workflows for Xcode projects.
defaultPrompt: Implement a SwiftUI feature and verify it with Xcode previews and a project build.
Add networking, concurrency, or localization to an Apple app feature and keep the architecture consistent.
Use the official Xcode MCP bridge to inspect the current project, fix compiler issues, and verify the result with the smallest relevant build or test run.
